'''Gantra Lea''' was a provincial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] town on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wor Tandell/Legends|Wor Tandell]]. In [[3963 BBY]] a Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Testament]]'' made a stop on the planet, while it's commander [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Telettoh]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Darth Malak|Malak]] were looking for [[Zayne Carrick]] and his band of renegades.
